Polar collects first-party browser events through Shopify’s App Pixel, and supported headless stores can use our SDK instead. Collection happens client-side. Processing then happens downstream, where we connect customer journeys and calculate attribution. The Pixel uses browser local storage and follows Shopify’s consent settings.

Polar integrates with Shopify’s customer-privacy settings. Where consent is required, tracking depends on the shopper’s consent and your store’s configuration. Shopify order reporting is separate from browser tracking, so a missing attribution doesn’t mean a missing sale.
